_readme: Central asset manifest. Every image, video still, artifact, logo-adjacent card, and metric marker on the site resolves through this file.

To replace a placeholder: drop the file into src/assets/<file> (images) or public/media/<file> (video), then set `file` (and `poster` for video) on the matching entry. No layout code changes are required.
`permission` must be one of: pending | approved | redacted | private-only. Only `approved` entries with a real file render on the public site.
Entries without an approved file render nothing in a production build. Labeled placeholders appear in `npm run dev` only, so the public site never shows a placeholder card.
Aspect ratios are strings like 16:9. A real file is cropped to it with object-fit: cover.
